description: What publishing a workspace would change: entities added, changed (with the changed fields, and renames) and deleted compared with the live version (or another version_id). Compares the actual contents, so it also shows changes that reached the live version after the workspace was created (the workspace then needs updating in GTM). Set include_values for the before/after values of changed fields.

account_id.description: Numeric Tag Manager account ID, from list_accounts.

container_id.description: Numeric container ID from list_containers, or the public ID ("GTM-XXXXXXX").

include_values.description: Include before/after values of the changed fields. Default false.

version_id.description: Compare against this version instead of the live one.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to compare, from list_workspaces.

name: diff
title: Diff a workspace against the live version
